mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.challengeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
mfa.enrolledBody: Your authenticator is set up. You can create new recovery codes later under Account, then Security.
mfa.enrollNotice: Back-office access requires a second factor. Set it up once; you'll be asked for a code at every sign-in.
mfa.setupKeyIntro: In your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…) choose {key} and type:
mfa.setupLinkIntro: On a phone with an authenticator installed you can also {link}.
mfa.recoveryWarning: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your authenticator. They won't be shown again.
mfa.currentCodeHint: Enter the current code shown in the app.
mfa.settingsIntro: Add a second step to sign-in using an authenticator app.
mfa.requiredForRole: It is required for your role.
mfa.recommended: Recommended for anyone who can spend credits or edit listings.
mfa.onNotice: Two-factor authentication is on. Recovery codes left: {count}.
mfa.regenHint: A current code is needed to make new recovery codes (the old ones stop working).
mfa.cannotDisable: Two-factor cannot be turned off for back-office accounts.
